userStories.title: Reject removed pipeline keys in every raw config layer
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Reject explicit pipeline mode and maxIterations at config load boundaries, normalize every config as workflow, and preserve acceptance-command testability through an injectable loader.

**Motivation** — Cutting the fork first makes wave B2 a pure deletion, because after B1 no production path reaches the pipeline-only modules.

**Approach** — Design Part 1: the config guard (US-001)

A new pre-parse guard in `packages/nax/src/config/config-guards.ts`, next to `rejectRemovedPlanModes`:

```typescript
/** Pipeline mode was removed (C1 B1). Runs on each raw config layer, before it is merged. */
export function rejectPipelineModeKeys(layer: Record<string, unknown>, source: string): void;
```

It reads `layer.execution`. When `execution` is an object and either its `mode` is the string `"pipeline"` or it has an own `maxIterations` key (any value), it throws:

```typescript
throw new NaxError(message, "CONFIG_PIPELINE_MODE_REMOVED", { stage: "config", source, keys });
```

`keys` lists the offending keys in this order: `"execution.mode"` (only when it is `"pipeline"`), then `"execution.maxIterations"`. `message` is these lines joined with `\n`:

```
Invalid configuration in <source> — pipeline mode was removed: <keys joined with ", ">.
Workflow mode is the only execution mode, and it bounds a run by its stories.
- execution.mode: remove it, or set it to "workflow".
- execution.maxIterations: remove it.
```

Only the bullet lines for keys in `keys` are printed. `execution.mode: "workflow"` and an absent `execution.mode` are accepted (user ruling 2026-11-05).

**Why per layer, not on the merged config.** `loadConfig` (`packages/nax/src/config/loader.ts:264`) starts from `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, which carries `execution.maxIterations: 20` (`schemas.ts:160`), so the merged object always has the key. The guard therefore runs on each raw layer, after its compat shims and before it is merged:

| Layer | Call site (loader) | `source` |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Global `~/.nax/config.json` | `applyGlobalLayer`, on `globalConf` | `"global config"` |
| Project `.nax/config.json` | `applyProjectLayer`, on `resolvedProjConf` | `"project config"` |
| Each root profile | `applyProfileChainLayer`, on `shimmedProfileData` | `` `profile "${name}"` `` |
| CLI overrides | `applyCliOverridesLayer`, on `shimmedCliOverrides` | `"CLI overrides"` |
| Per-package `.nax/mono/<pkg>/config.json` | `loadConfigForWorkdir` path, on `shimmedPackageFields` | `` `per-package config "${packageDir}"` `` |
| Each per-package profile | `loadPackageProfileLayers` (`package-profile.ts:16`), on each `layer` | `` `per-package profile "${name}" (${packageDir})` `` |

The guard is never called on a merged object: not in `finalizeAndValidateRootConfig` (`loader.ts:213-252`, where `rejectRemovedPlanModes` sits at `:222`) and not on the per-package `rawMerged` (`loader.ts:538-546`). Both carry the default `maxIterations: 20` and would reject every config.

The schema keeps `ExecutionModeSchema = z.enum(["pipeline", "workflow"])` and `execution.maxIterations` with its default until wave B3, so hand-built test configs that carry the literal still typecheck. The guard is the only thing that rejects them.

**Normalisation.** `applyWorkflowMode` (`config/workflow-mode.ts:17`) drops its `isWorkflowMode` check and applies the workflow overrides to every config it is given (acceptance off, the advisor on when an advisor block exists, story isolation shared). A loaded config can no longer be in pipeline mode, so this changes nothing for a config that loads; it changes the result only for a hand-built config that still says `mode: "pipeline"`. The `warnDeprecatedPipelineMode` call in `finalizeAndValidateRootConfig` (`loader.ts:250`) is removed; the function itself is deleted in US-006.

**`nax features acceptance` keeps its tests.** `resolveFeatureAcceptance` (`packages/nax/src/cli/features-acceptance.ts:78`) reads `config.acceptance.enabled` from `loadConfig`. Its tests, and those of `resolveFeatures` and the `features resolve` CLI, used `execution.mode: "pipeline"` in their fixture so acceptance stayed on. That route is closed by the guard and the normalisation. The module gains an injectable seam so the tests can keep driving the acceptance-on path:

```typescript
export const _featuresAcceptanceDeps = { loadConfig };
```

`resolveFeatureAcceptance` calls `_featuresAcceptanceDeps.loadConfig(workdir, configOverrides)` in place of `loadConfig(workdir, configOverrides)`. Production behaviour is unchanged. Wave B2 decides whether the command stays.

**Fixture migration** — Apply the US-001 test migrations recorded in analysis: remove obsolete pipeline identity/package-acceptance expectations; change the deferred deprecation test to CONFIG_PIPELINE_MODE_REMOVED; use loader wrappers restored in afterEach for acceptance-on unit paths; expect disabled in spawned features-resolve CLI tests; retain CONFIG_SCHEMA_INVALID for bogus storyIsolation; replace maxIterations merge/view/diff fixture pins with costLimit using the same numbers and its description. Retain the deprecation helper's describe/import until US-006. Extend existing guard and loader suites rather than weakening invalid-config checks.

**Scope** — In: guard, six raw-layer integrations, unconditional workflow normalization, root warning-call removal, acceptance seam and directly affected fixtures. Out: execution-loop fork removal (US-002), setup/dispatch (US-003), run flags (US-004), chat contracts (US-005), and deletion of deprecated helpers (US-006). Do not narrow schemas/defaults, reject other pipeline-only keys, remove acceptance commands, or edit user config.

**Interface** —
```typescript
export function rejectPipelineModeKeys(layer: Record<string, unknown>, source: string): void;
(config: NaxConfig, warn: (msg: string) => void): NaxConfig
export const _featuresAcceptanceDeps = { loadConfig };
```
The second signature is the unchanged applyWorkflowMode contract. The seam AC uses an initialized dir because resolveFeatureAcceptance returns before loading config if no .nax directory exists. In the two-argument call the forwarded configOverrides is undefined; a supplied third argument must be forwarded unchanged. The wrapper used by acceptance-on fixtures must call the saved real loadConfig function, not the replaced seam recursively.

userStories.title: Keep only workflow execution and completion arms
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make iteration selection, loop bounds, preflight, completion reporting and the end phase use their workflow behavior regardless of a hand-built config's mode literal.

**Motivation** — Until the fork is cut, none of the pipeline-only code can be deleted: it is still reachable from a config that sets `execution.mode: "pipeline"`.

**Approach** — Design Part 2: the run loop and end phase (US-002)

Each site keeps only its workflow arm:

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `selectPipeline` (`execution/iteration-runner.ts:41-44`) | returns `stages.getWorkflowPipeline()` |
| `runEndPhase` (`execution/end-phase.ts:187-195`) | calls `runWorkflowEnd(options, deps, branch)` and returns its result; return type `Promise<EndPhaseOutcome>`; the `runFinish` call and import go |
| `shouldSkipRegression` (`execution/runner-completion.ts:467-469`) | removed; the deferred regression gate is never run from `runner-completion.ts` |
| the `gate.ensureSafely` block (`runner-completion.ts:579-586`) | always `featureWorkflowDurationMs: 0` and `workflowPassed: false` |
| `isSequential` (`runner-completion.ts:396`) | `true`; the `effectiveParallelCount` import goes |
| `loopIterationLimit` (`execution/iteration-bound.ts:33-42`) | returns `iterationsDone + workflowIterationsRemaining(prd, config, lastStoryId)` |
| `logIterationCapReached` (`execution/unified-executor.ts:44-58`) | always logs the derived-bound message (`Exit reason max-iterations: the derived loop bound (<limit>) was exhausted with ...`) |
| `nextLoopGuard` (`unified-executor.ts:66-80`) | always computes the progress signature and the derived limit |
| `runWorkflowPreflightOnce` (`unified-executor.ts:83-84`) | skips only on a dry run |
| the defence-in-depth completion check (`unified-executor.ts:303`) | runs on every iteration exit: `if (await refreshedIsComplete())` |
| the `catch` path of `handleRunCompletion` (`execution/lifecycle/run-completion.ts:302-318`) | the held-back `run:completed` event always carries `workflowPassed: false`; the `isWorkflowMode` import (`:22`) goes |

`runFinish`, `runFinishPhase` (and `EndPhaseDeps.runFinishPhase`), `runDeferredRegression` and `defaultPipeline` stay exported and unchanged; wave B2 deletes them. The `outcome === undefined` handling in `execution/workflow-end-report.ts` becomes unreachable and stays for wave B2.

**Baseline clarification** — runFinish is actually a local helper in end-phase.ts, not an import/export in this checkout; retain it unchanged and remove its invocation. Do not introduce a new export merely to match that baseline wording. Keep runFinishPhase and the EndPhaseDeps member. Make skipRegression unconditional rather than deleting the underlying regression implementation.

**Test migration** — Follow the US-002 inventory in analysis. Keep workflow halves, delete pipeline-only finish/status/duration/event expectations, replace deferred-regression assertions with never-called cases, and migrate finish/re-login timing stubs to runWorkflowFeature returning null. Remove obsolete fixed-cap fixtures and arrange PRDs/stub outcomes to progress and settle under the derived bound, including direct parallel integration stubs; do not delete direct parallel dispatch coverage. Keep intentional makeNaxConfig({execution:{mode:"pipeline"}}) regression cases from the ACs. Preserve workflow null-result passed=true semantics, exactly-once held-back events, drain-before-rethrow, runtime-close ordering and existing max-iterations exitReason.

**Scope** — In: iteration-runner.ts, end-phase.ts, runner-completion.ts, iteration-bound.ts, unified-executor.ts, lifecycle/run-completion.ts and their behavioral test migrations. Out: raw config rejection (US-001), setup/batch/parallel harness wiring (US-003), CLI rejection (US-004), chat changes (US-005), shared-helper deletion (US-006). Pipeline-only runFinish/runFinishPhase, deferred regression, stages, parallel/batch dispatch, post-run acceptance and undefined-outcome fallback deletion remain B2 work.

**Interface** —
```typescript
(options: RunnerCompletionOptions, deps: EndPhaseDeps): Promise<EndPhaseOutcome>
```
This is the target runEndPhase contract. loopIterationLimit keeps the same signature and always returns the derived bound; workflowIterationsRemaining and progressSignature retain their existing algorithms.

**Failure-fixture and observation notes** — runFinish is private: prove that it is unreachable by observing zero calls to the retained deps.runFinishPhase seam while deps.runWorkflowFeature runs once. A null workflow maps to { passed: true, reasons: [] } with no url. For the gate.ensureSafely rejection ACs, inject rejection through the existing _endPhaseDeps.resolveBranch seam, before runWorkflowEnd's caught body, so the end phase really rejects before the completion gate closes; merely throwing from runWorkflowFeature is caught and converted to a negative EndPhaseOutcome and does not exercise that fallback. Observe the summary through the deferred logRunComplete/emitRunCompleted callbacks. Retain the existing workflow-duration tests for caught workflow failures, which report workflowPassed false while returning normally. Read execution/iteration-bound.ts as an additional known implementation file; the five context slots mirror the spec, including lifecycle/run-completion.ts for the separate catch-path event assertion.

userStories.title: Make run setup and harness dispatch unconditionally workflow
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Create workflow run resources for every non-dry run and force harness dispatch to sequential, unbatched execution without ignored-option warnings.

**Motivation** — Pipeline mode has been deprecated since v0.88.0 and frozen since 2026-10-16.

**Approach** — Design Part 3: run setup and dispatch (US-003)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `runMemoryFor` (`execution/lifecycle/run-setup.ts:123-126`) | returns `undefined` only on a dry run |
| `withRuleDeliveryHandlers` (`execution/lifecycle/run-rules-setup.ts:161-167`) | the `isWorkflowMode` early return goes; the `delivery !== "index"` check stays |
| `runExecutionPhase` (`execution/runner-execution.ts:122`, `:274`) | `useBatch` is `false`; `parallelCount` is not passed to the executor; neither warns |
| `run` (`execution/runner.ts:185`) | `useBatch` is `false`, with no warning |
| `parallel-worker.ts:93`, `merge-conflict-rectify.ts:221` | the `assertPipelineMode` call and import go |

`RunnerOptions.useBatch`, `RunnerExecutionOptions.useBatch` and `.parallel` stay as fields, read by nothing, for wave B2 to remove with the parallel modules. `--no-batch` stays accepted by `nax run`.

**Test migration** — Remove pipeline-no-memory tests from run-setup-memory.test.ts; retain the dry-run guard and add the hand-built pipeline-config non-dry assertion. In run-rules-setup-agent-hooks.test.ts, replace testConfig({workflow:false}) with a non-index delivery setting, remove the helper's workflow option, and preserve plugin identity/append-order assertions. Delete test/unit/execution/runner-execution-workflow-parallel.test.ts and runner-execution-workflow-batch.test.ts because they only test obsolete clamp/assertion helpers. Keep workflow-parallel.ts itself until US-006. Exercise the production runExecutionPhase and run entry points for unbatched/no-parallelCount behavior, and directly exercise executeStoryInWorktree with a workflow root to prove only the assertion was severed.

**Scope** — In: run-setup.ts, run-rules-setup.ts, runner-execution.ts, runner.ts, parallel-worker.ts, merge-conflict-rectify.ts and related tests. Out: config guard/normalization (US-001), loop/end-phase simplification (US-002), CLI flag rejection (US-004), chat propagation (US-005), and deletion of workflow-parallel.ts (US-006). Do not remove the retained option fields, --no-batch, pipeline stages or parallel/batch modules; B2 owns those deletions.

userStories.title: Reject removed max-iterations and parallel run flags
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Fail fast with explicit removal messages for nax run -m/--max-iterations and --parallel while preserving help discovery, chat-asks parsing, agent overrides and max-cost handling.

**Motivation** — Cutting the fork first makes wave B2 a pure deletion, because after B1 no production path reaches the pipeline-only modules.

**Approach** — Design Part 4: the `nax run` flags (US-004)

`parseRunPreconditionFlags` (`packages/nax/bin/run-action.ts:134-161`) checks, in this order, before any config load:

1. `options.maxIterations !== undefined` → prints, in red on stderr, `nax run -m/--max-iterations was removed: workflow mode bounds a run by its stories` and exits 1.
2. `options.parallel !== undefined` → prints, in red on stderr, `nax run --parallel was removed: workflow mode runs stories one at a time` and exits 1.

The return type loses `maxIterationsFlag` and `parallel`: `{ chatAsksDir: string | undefined }`. `applyRunCliOverrides` (`run-action.ts:491-515`) drops its `maxIterationsFlag` parameter and the `applyMaxIterationsFlag` / `maxIterationsIgnoredNotice` calls; the `--agent` and `--max-cost` handling stays. The signature change is verified by `bun run typecheck`, not by an acceptance criterion, and the existing `--agent` / `--max-cost` tests keep passing. In `bin/nax.ts` the two options stay declared, so the removal message prints instead of commander's generic unknown-option error; their help text becomes `Removed: workflow mode sets its own limits`. The `parallel` value passed to the runner (`bin/nax.ts:395`) goes.

**Test migration** — Update test/integration/cli/cli-run-max-iterations.test.ts using its real Bun.spawn spawnRun harness: replace numeric validation/uninitialized-project assertions with the -m 5 removal result before initialization. Similarly replace AC-11/AC-12 in cli-run-parallel.test.ts with --parallel 2 rejection before initialization. Add direct precondition assertions for flag precedence, red stderr, exit 1 and the sole chatAsksDir return key; retain actual CLI boundary tests and help assertions. Extend surviving unit/CLI suites as appropriate; old run-max-iterations.ts and run-parallel.ts helper-only tests and sources are deleted in US-006, not here.

**Scope** — In: bin/run-action.ts preconditions and override signature, bin/nax.ts declarations/help and call sites, and surviving flag integration/unit tests. Out: chat maxIterations rejection and forwarding (US-005), helper module/test deletion (US-006), config loading changes (US-001), execution-loop behavior (US-002), dispatch setup (US-003). **Interface** —
```typescript
(options: RunActionOptions): { chatAsksDir: string | undefined }
(config: NaxConfig, options: RunActionOptions): NaxConfig
```
These are the target parseRunPreconditionFlags and applyRunCliOverrides signatures, respectively.
